summary: Louisiana Forestry Commission tower completed west of Leesville in 1949; a 1972 survey and a 2011 tower list are the only later records; current condition not found.

events.note: Completion of a forest-fire lookout tower just west of Leesville reported in a late-August 1949 newspaper item (The Bunkie Record, as reprinted on the site).
Federal survey (National Geodetic Survey) describes the tower as under Louisiana Forestry Commission management, about 2.5 miles west of Leesville.
Listed in a Louisiana lookout tower list revised May 2011; the list gives coordinates only and does not describe condition.

notes_for_editor: Status is still unknown after two searches and the cached Wikipedia list (which does not contain Leesville, Olla or Plain Dealing at all). The NHLR Louisiana page lists 7 registered lookouts, none of them these three. The 1972 survey station is PID BX2914, listed on the Central Louisiana Lookouts transcription page; its NGS datasheet was not fetched, so the description is quoted via that transcription. A city-data.com FCC registration page titled 'Leesville Lookout Tower' appeared in search results but was not read and is not used; it may refer to a later radio structure at the site. Brief coordinates (31.1418, -93.2923) agree with the 2011 list within about 0.001 degree, so no correction.
